title.zh: Europe’s central banks want to scrap this stablecoin reserve safeguard
title.en: Europe’s central banks want to scrap this stablecoin reserve safeguard

current_state.zh: The European System of Central Banks has recommended scrapping MiCA's requirement that stablecoin issuers hold 30-60% of reserves in commercial bank deposits, instead favoring short-maturity reserve assets, aligning EU rules closer to Britain's systemic sterling stablecoin policy that excludes bank deposits from coin backing.
current_state.en: The European System of Central Banks has recommended scrapping MiCA's requirement that stablecoin issuers hold 30-60% of reserves in commercial bank deposits, instead favoring short-maturity reserve assets, aligning EU rules closer to Britain's systemic sterling stablecoin policy that excludes bank deposits from coin backing.
